title: The design-flag registry of the atmosphere recipes
note: Rows whose quantity no ensemble can define: no exoplanet measures it, or it is whether life makes a gas. Each keeps a labelled design bracket, is off unless one of its enabling flags is set, and is never tuned (decision D4 of docs/design/composition/tunable-gaps.md).

flags.stands_for: nitrous oxide (N2O) as a biosignature, or from weakly reducing air driven by stellar energetic particles
flags.why_not_tuned: no exoplanet has a measured N2O; tuning to the Earth's 400 ppbv would fix the Solar System into the generator
flags.label: DESIGN

flags.why_not_tuned: no exoplanet has a measured PH3 and the Venus claim is contested by two read papers; tuning to 20 ppb would fix the Solar System into the generator
flags.label: DESIGN

flags.stands_for: nitrogen dioxide (NO2) from lightning or from a biosphere
flags.why_not_tuned: no exoplanet has a measured NO2; the only lightning rate is the modern Earth's
flags.label: DESIGN
